storage: Keep refrigerated at all times; once opened, use within 2 to 3 days and keep covered. Let it sit out of the fridge for a short time before whisking into hot gravy so it does not split.
looksLike: Soft white set yoghurt, slightly tangy; sold in pouches and cups.
howToPick: Check the date, a firm set with little watery whey, a clean tangy smell. Avoid bulging packs, off smells or pink or grey patches.
shelfLife: Packed curd lasts about 5 to 7 days in the fridge (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Buttermilk or lemon juice in water
